mission_08: Frequency encoding replaces each category with its count or proportion in the dataset. This is a simple yet effective encoding method for high-cardinality categorical variables. Unlike target encoding, frequency encoding does not use the target variable, avoiding data leakage concerns. Categories that appear frequently get higher encoded values, which can capture the intuition that common categories may behave differently from rare ones. In this mission, you will implement both count-based and proportion-based frequency encoding and compare them with label encoding.
